name: ai-animation-studio-skill-os
description: Machine-readable catalog of Antigravity production knowledge and workflow skills for AI Animation Studio.

skills.name: Studio Router
skills.description: Central Antigravity entry point and skill router for AI Animation Studio. Analyzes requests and routes to specialized domain skills.

skills.name: Repository Audit
skills.description: Inspects repository health, git status, architecture, tests, and dependencies before modifying any code.

skills.name: Architecture Review
skills.description: Protects core architectural tenets: provider independence, universe persistence, candidate!=canon, source preservation, determinism.

skills.name: Implementation Discipline
skills.description: Governs controlled feature implementation using the 8-step cycle: READ -> PLAN -> IMPLEMENT -> TEST -> REVIEW -> FIX -> VALIDATE -> REPORT.

skills.name: Testing Strategy
skills.description: Defines mandatory testing gates: typecheck, lint, unit tests, integration tests, build, and regression suites.

skills.name: Root-Cause Debugging
skills.description: Disciplined debugging workflow: reproduce -> isolate -> root-cause -> regression test -> fix -> verify.

skills.name: Phase Gate Audit
skills.description: Mandatory readiness checkpoint before concluding any development phase. Outputs COMPLETE or NOT COMPLETE.

skills.name: Release Security
skills.description: Audits repository, artifacts, and CLI invocations for secret leakage, command injection, path traversal, and test-to-production boundary leakage.

skills.name: Release Validation
skills.description: Governs the release gate across ten stratified verification states, enforcing doctor checks, provider provenance, media integrity, human approvals, and security audits.

skills.name: Story Analysis
skills.description: Extracts narrative beats, characters, dialogue, locations, and emotional arcs from raw text while preserving original text.

skills.name: Source Preservation
skills.description: Enforces user source text immutability and bidirectional source-offset traceability.

skills.name: Story Coverage & Hallucination Guard
skills.description: Audits narrative coverage against source text to prevent dropped plot beats and hallucinated content.

skills.name: Canon Conflict Detection
skills.description: Identifies contradictions between story candidate claims and persistent canonical universe facts.

skills.name: Universe Resolution
skills.description: Resolves narrative entities against canonical persistent series universe models while respecting namespace boundaries.

skills.name: Character Resolution
skills.description: Resolves character mentions to persistent canonical character entities, managing versioning and aliases.

skills.name: World State & Continuity
skills.description: Tracks mutable universe conditions (time of day, weather, damage) and validates continuity across narrative beats.

skills.name: Scene Directing
skills.description: Translates narrative beats into scene-level directing strategies, shot breakdowns, and cinematic pacing.

skills.name: Shot Planning
skills.description: Deconstructs a directed scene beat into a coherent sequence of provider-neutral ShotContracts.

skills.name: Master Cinematography
skills.description: Master cinematography knowledge translating narrative intent into semantic camera, framing, composition, motion, and transitions.

skills.name: Character Consistency
skills.description: Rules and workflows for maintaining visual identity, facial features, proportions, and outfit continuity across shots.

skills.name: Identity QA
skills.description: Quality assurance protocol for verifying visual character fidelity, detecting identity drift, and costume discrepancies.

skills.name: Environment Resolution
skills.description: Resolves environment, architectural layout, spatial geometry, and lighting states from canonical location DNA.

skills.name: Production Routing
skills.description: Evaluates ShotContract specifications and chooses optimal execution paths (Deterministic HyperFrames vs Generative Video).

skills.name: HyperFrames Production Strategy
skills.description: Instructs agents when and how AI Animation Studio delegates deterministic shot execution to HyperFrames compositions.

skills.name: Reference Role Binding
skills.description: Discipline for binding multimodal reference assets to explicit semantic roles (identity, pose, outfit, environment, motion).

skills.name: Shot Continuation
skills.description: Chains consecutive shots across cut boundaries, extracting terminal states from shot N to seed shot N+1.

skills.name: Retake Protocol
skills.description: Root-cause diagnostic and surgical re-generation protocol for failing shots, isolating and modifying only responsible variables.

skills.name: Live Provider Validation
skills.description: Governs live external AI provider execution (Gemini), role-based model policies, single-credential enforcement, quota discipline, and provider provenance without faking live evidence.

skills.name: Production Trust & Evidence
skills.description: Guards the production truth model, verifies physical media and cryptographic provenance, and enforces fail-closed derivation of MASTER_PRODUCTION_VERIFIED.

skills.name: Flow Operator Workflow
skills.description: Governs the human-assisted Google Flow video generation boundary, handoff packaging, media import validation, and operator escalation protocols.

skills.name: Continuity QA
skills.description: Comprehensive continuity verification across character identities, outfits, props, screen direction, lighting, and timeline.

skills.name: Visual QA
skills.description: Inspection criteria for rendered video frames and animations, detecting artifacts, anatomical flaws, and layer clipping.

skills.name: Director QA
skills.description: Audits directed shot sequences and ShotContracts against narrative intent, director profile, and cinematic grammar.

externalSkills.name: HyperFrames Root
externalSkills.description: Root official HyperFrames skill for declarative motion design and camera choreography.

externalSkills.name: HyperFrames Core
externalSkills.description: Core composition primitives, audio, and asset specs for HyperFrames.

externalSkills.name: HyperFrames Animation
externalSkills.description: Animation syntax, easing, camera movements, and layer transforms in HyperFrames.
